name: homebase-kit
title_zh: 新机开机一小时后，Claude Code 已认得你家
tagline_zh: 刚拿到手的电脑和账号，跑一遍就把规则、措辞风格、常用技能、插件全铺好。
tagline_en: Fresh machine + fresh account → one run lays down rules, style, pinned skills, plugins, a Mission Control UI on.
desc_en: One repo that turns a fresh machine and a fresh Claude Code account into a working HomeBase: rules, Plain English style, pinned skills and plugins, a Mission Control UI on the subscription login, and a daily memory backup.
why_zh: 不是零散贴配置，是整套 HomeBase 状态机：先铺规则再验技能，最后挂 UI 和备份。
why_en: Not scattered dotfiles—a real state machine: rules first, skills verified, then UI and backup. If the order breaks, it stops and.
limit_zh: 只服务 Claude Code 官方订阅登录页，不碰第三方 IDE 或 API 直连；备份只走本地 git 仓库。
limit_en: Only for Claude Code subscription login—no third-party IDEs or raw API. Backups are local git only, no remote push. Mission Control is a launcher.

install.note: clone 下来，挑你要的那件复制进 ~/.claude/skills/。这是一个合集，没有「装它」这个动作。

title_en: One hour from bare metal to a Claude Code that knows your.
